metadata.description:
​​Nice to Meet You is a comedy show for kids that will make the whole family laugh.

On his private space station high above Earth, Professor Burkhead has begun conducting a ground-breaking social experiment. Each week, his “Uniﬁer” pairs together two unlikely creatures and puts them in a room together where the two subjects (an accountant and a giant squid, one week; a porcupine and a ballerina the next, etc) talk, debate, get to know each other, and maybe learn something new about themselves in the process.

For more great shows and to listen early and ad-free, visit ⁠GZMShows.com⁠.
